status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE 0.2.15 / code 18; surface grips, separate squeeze triggers, independent nozzle and direct station controls; 210 EditMode + 188 PlayMode passed; both APKs audited. Physical hand comfort, tracking and thresholds require headset acceptance.
user_intent: Stable latched ownership, separate light grip and firing squeeze, actual surface grabs with functional regions, independently held extinguisher nozzle, and direct pump/wheel/button operations. Keep hand tracking.

input_contract.menu: Retain 0.2.13 hand aim and fresh pinch for menus. Object pose acquisition does not require a valid menu pointer.
input_contract.measurement: Mean of four tracked finger curls, independent from thumb/index pinch. Require valid observations; never use missing data as an open hand. Quest uses raw SDK joint data and confidence. Portable XR uses fresh native Dynamic joint samples and validity.
input_contract.ownership: Pickup follows actual rendered part bounds, preserving contact offset and relative pose. Either hand may initially carry a tool. Body grips do not gain trigger permission.
input_contract.regrasp: Opening only the carrying hand parks the tool for a new surface grasp. If both hands remain fully open and valid for 0.5 seconds, the separate release gesture returns it to the rack. No gravity drop animation or remote closed-hand reacquisition.
input_contract.return: Either leave the rack, bring the tool back and open the carrying hand near its geometry for 0.35 seconds; OR keep both valid tracked hands fully open anywhere for 0.5 seconds. Any hand reclosing, invalid tracking or UI interruption resets the dual-open dwell. Both routes use intentional rack return with charge cancellation. Existing explicit Return Tool, shop and scene-transition commands remain.
input_contract.arbitration: A hand physically carrying, holding the nozzle, supporting the barrel or operating the pump cannot simultaneously activate menu buttons. A parked tool frees the primary hand for UI; an unoccupied other hand can still use menus.
input_contract.tracking_loss: Cancel actions/charge and retain the tool pose. No stale sample may trigger a release shot or reacquire the nozzle. Dock interruptions park the tool for deliberate regrasp.
input_contract.hand_presentation: Use the real tracked skeleton during physical interactions; do not force a body grip into the authored trigger hand pose.

equipment.Extinguisher: Top handle grants firing permission. A second hand must grasp the movable nozzle; its actual world pose directs the stream. Light grip holds, tight squeeze sprays, relaxing stops. The hose is tethered to 0.45 m.
equipment.PulsePistol: Squeeze only from the grip for repeated pulses. Body and reservoir grabs carry only. Optional forward support steers the barrel around the retained primary contact.
equipment.RainFan: Grip squeeze produces the existing fan stream. Optional forward support steers the tool; relaxing the firing hand stops flow without releasing ownership.
equipment.PressureCannon: Grip squeeze charges and relaxing to a light grip launches. Full opening enters regrasp and cancels charge. Optional side-pump grasp retains pull-and-release charging/firing, gated by primary trigger-grip permission; tracking loss or leaving its bounds cancels. Front support and pump ownership are mutually exclusive.

water_controls.dock: Use the real coupling pose; preserve distance/angle/dwell. Tight firing squeeze cannot dock. Do not auto-rotate arbitrary body grips into docking alignment.
water_controls.lever: Fresh light grasp, downward stroke and complete return; unfinished, released or lost-tracking strokes do not transfer water. Empty outlet remains feedback only.
water_controls.valve: Grasp the rim and move tangentially around its plane. Wrist rotation or axial translation alone cannot turn it. Reject center-axis grasps and discontinuous angular jumps.
water_controls.button: Approach the front then physically push the fingertip through the contact plane. Toggle once per press, withdraw before another press; holding cannot repeatedly toggle.
water_controls.creek: Grasp and place the intake on the existing target, then grasp and complete pump pull/return cycles. Preserve existing supply amounts and source progression.
water_controls.legacy_test_contract: Existing non-UsesGrip synthetic adapters retain their explicit pinch contract for prior regression coverage. Production object samples opt into UsesGrip; invalid closure never falls back to pinch.

unchanged: Water capacity, flow, stroke yield and recovery
Both water stations remain available under existing progression
acceptance_limits: Thresholds are initial normalized curl targets, not measured squeeze pressure or hardware-calibrated hand poses.
Editor synthetic joints and rendered captures do not establish real headset tracking stability, comfort, reach or performance.
Whole-tool hand-to-hand transfer and gravity-based dropping are not added; regrasp uses the parked-tool rule.
Right-side creek-pump removal from ordinary levels remains a separate proposal.
